mechanism: Valerian may potentiate CNS depression effects of meloxicam and both substances can increase gastrointestinal bleeding risk through different pathways (NSAID gastric irritation and valerian's anticoagulant properties).
action: Monitor patients for increased CNS depression, dizziness, and GI symptoms; counsel on alcohol avoidance and advise taking meloxicam with food; consider alternative anxiolytic if CNS effects become problematic.
